items.q: Write an Arduino sketch that blinks an LED while a button is held
items.reply:
<title>
// Blink the LED on pin 13 while the button on pin 2 is held
const int LED_PIN = 13;
const int BUTTON_PIN = 2;

unsigned long lastToggle = 0;
bool ledOn = false;

void setup() {
  pinMode(LED_PIN, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(BUTTON_PIN, INPUT_PULLUP);
  Serial.begin(9600);
}

void loop() {
  bool pressed = digitalRead(BUTTON_PIN) == LOW;
  if (pressed && millis() - lastToggle >= 500) {
    lastToggle = millis();
    ledOn = !ledOn;
    digitalWrite(LED_PIN, ledOn ? HIGH : LOW);
    Serial.println(ledOn ? "on" : "off");
  }
  if (!pressed) {
    digitalWrite(LED_PIN, LOW);
    ledOn = false;
  }
}
</title>

items.q: Write a python program that counts down from 10 to liftoff
items.reply:
language python
import time

def count_down(n):
    while n > 0:
        print(n)
        time.sleep(1)
        n -= 1
    print("Liftoff!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    count_down(10)

**How it works:**
- `count_down` prints each number
- `time.sleep(1)` waits a second

items.q: Write an Arduino sketch that blinks an LED while a button is held
items.reply:
<title>Blink</title>
language arduino
// Blink the LED on pin 13 while the button on pin 2 is held
const int LED_PIN = 13;
const int BUTTON_PIN = 2;

unsigned long lastToggle = 0;
bool ledOn = false;

void setup() {
  pinMode(LED_PIN, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(BUTTON_PIN, INPUT_PULLUP);
  Serial.begin(9600);
}

void loop() {
  bool pressed = digitalRead(BUTTON_PIN) == LOW;
  if (pressed && millis() - lastToggle >= 500) {
    lastToggle = millis();
    ledOn = !ledOn;
    digitalWrite(LED_PIN, ledOn ? HIGH : LOW);
    Serial.println(ledOn ? "on" : "off");
  }
  if (!pressed) {
    digitalWrite(LED_PIN, LOW);
    ledOn = false;
  }
}

Upload this sketch, then hold the button: the LED blinks twice a second.
